title: Syracuse recordings and leading his own groups
summary: Moore recorded at the Dinkler in Syracuse and led groups while playing with Lanin.

blocks.x: Well, in the '70s, you went to the Dinkler Motor Inn in Syracuse where you recorded.
Yes, there Claude Hopkins is on that.
Ivan Rolle who is now playing with Jonah Jones, I think -- he was with Jonah Jones.
And is that the same group, this quartet, do they play other places besides the Dinkler, besides Syracuse?
No, we play at other places.
So in the '70s, the last ten years, you've been leading your own groups and you've also been with Lester Lanin.
I've been with my own group or made guest appearances, besides my starring role with Lester Lanin, bringing jazz to the society people.
